description: Covers B53, B58. ui_host.cpp hk_DIState/hk_DIData read the route state under a lock or as one atomic word, and WM_ACTIVATEAPP clears s_rmlOwner with the button masks (B53, from the W2 review); gesture.cpp: no adapter callback under the non-re-entrant s_lock, WM_CAPTURECHANGED as focus loss, ctl gesture press holds only after a begin, one D3DSBT_ALL state block reused across preview frames, and a ctl smoke walk (B58 a to e, from the W6 review).
title: UI host and gesture driver hardening
